mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_info (id, api_name, api_path, description, create_by, create_time, update_time, status, api_type, sql_content, sql_database_name, need_pagination, page_size) VALUES (#{id}, #{apiName}, #{apiPath}, #{description}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{status}, #{apiType}, #{sqlContent}, #{sqlDatabaseName}, #{needPagination}, #{pageSize})
mapper.update: UPDATE api_info SET api_name = #{apiName}, api_path = #{apiPath}, description = #{description}, create_by = #{createBy}, update_time = #{updateTime}, status = #{status}, api_type = #{apiType}, sql_content = #{sqlContent}, sql_database_name = #{sqlDatabaseName}, need_pagination = #{needPagination}, page_size = #{pageSize} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM api_info
AND api_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{apiName}, '%')
AND api_path LIKE CONCAT('%', #{apiPath}, '%')
ORDER BY create_time DESC
